item.title: Oneonta Police searching for missing vulnerable Oneonta woman
item.description: The Oneonta Police Department is asking for the public's help in locating a missing Oneonta woman.

item.title: New York State Senate passes environmental package to counter federal rollbacks
item.description: The New York State Senate Democratic Majority advanced nine bills to reduce industrial pollution, remove toxic chemicals from consumer goods, and increase corporate transparency, in response to environmental deregulation under the Trump administration.

item.title: Utica Zoo mourns loss of red panda
item.description: The Utica Zoo announced on Wednesday the loss of one of their most beloved animals at the age of seven years old.

item.title: New York Democrats want to ban surveillance pricing, digital price tags
item.description: New York Democrats have proposed two bills to ban surveillance pricing, which uses personal data to charge different prices to different customers, and to protect consumers and jobs from discriminatory pricing.

item.title: John Wildhack to retire as SU Director of Athletics
item.description: John Wildhack has announced his resignation as Director of Athletics at Syracuse University after 10 years in the role, coinciding with the departure of Chancellor Kent Syverud.

item.title: Oneida County, MVCAA offering Lead Rental Registry inspections
item.description: If you are the landlord of a property built before 1980, you have likely heard of the Lead Rental Registry. Oneida County is looking to help you keep up with the law.

item.title: Push for 'Invest in Our New York' tax hikes on Tin Cup Day
item.description: Advocates, activists, and elected officials gathered at the New York State Capitol to demand higher taxes on the state's wealthiest residents and corporations to generate billions to protect childcare and healthcare from federal budget cuts.
